scenes.title: ZJU Low-Turbulence Wind Tunnel
scenes.institution: Aircraft Design Laboratory — Low-Turbulence Quiet Wind Tunnel
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Deep blue sheet-metal tunnel with large polygonal transition and repeated exterior stiffeners. The equipment occupies a tall white structural bay; the camera only reveals one side and does not establish a complete room plan.

scenes.title: NTU Taiwan IAM Teaching Wind Tunnel
scenes.institution: Institute of Applied Mechanics — Fluid Mechanics Teaching Laboratory
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Large yellow rectangular inlet with several bolted flange plates narrows toward a glazed test section. The downstream shell changes to circular ducting; the assembly stands on repeated yellow wheeled frames. A right-side table carries electronic acquisition hardware and many thin pressure tubes; window wall and tiled ceiling establish the immediate bay.

scenes.title: Osaka Two-Dimensional Wave Tank
scenes.institution: Ocean Space Development Laboratory — Two-Dimensional Wave Tank
scenes.reference_notes: Official laboratory page and its installed apparatus photograph reviewed. Long narrow transparent-sided channel has turquoise longitudinal beams and repeated floor supports. Tall aluminium profiles at the near end and a small cross-channel fixture form distinct local test hardware. A clear right-hand aisle follows the tank beside windows; hoses and instruments occupy the far end and left work area.

equipment.role: Translate a local carriage and adjust a visible inert test coupon above the static water visualization.
equipment.evidence: Original geometry from inspected official photo; dimensions and hidden mechanics estimated

support.evidence: Repeated turquoise floor frames support the tank; traverse rails fasten to the top framing and the coupon is clamped to its vertical rod.
